targets.title: A boom with review: How retrospective oversight increases the foreign policy ability of democracies.
targets.evidence_quote:
We selected the claim that the foreign policy ability of democracies with
national security oversight institutions should be, ceteris paribus, higher than democracies that
lack these types of institutions.
